label: Global Euclidean access gives Euclidean access at one world
description: Transcription by instantiation (AGENTS.md invariant 16), registered as a strength order (not a route step): global Euclidean access, instantiated at the selected world w, is Euclidean access at w on the same frame. The proof only instantiates the premise, so it closes its conclusion only when that premise is closed. The converse fails in Control.clustered.
